name: WOODS Steakhouse
kurzbeschreibung:
**WOODS Steakhouse in Tirol** – Where hearty flavors meet alpine charm.

Indulge in premium cuts of beef, handcrafted burgers, and a selection of fine wines in a rustic yet refined setting. Whether you crave a classic **Tiroler Gröstl** or a perfectly grilled steak, our menu celebrates the best of **Tirol**’s culinary traditions.

Located in the heart of **Innsbruck**, just steps from the **Goldenes Dachl**, **WOODS** offers an unforgettable dining experience—whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply savoring the flavors of the region.

Try our signature **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert, paired with a glass of local **Apfelstrudelwein**—a sweet finish to your alpine feast.

Reservations recommended. **Guten Appetit!**
